mass_source: Renault Histoire: 250 kg (Wikipedia gives 200 kg). No occupants.

steering_servo.note: Driver's grip on the handlebar (0.2 m half-width: 30 N m is 150 N).

tire.note: Pneumatic tyre (the Type A used Continental tyres): same stated compliance as 006/007 (k 2300 s^-2, b 48 s^-1 per unit mass, ~6 Hz), round crown with 30 mm half-width. Pneumatic tyres are softer than solid ones; the common compliance is an approximation.

assumptions: Mass split, centre of mass (front engine, rear seat, no occupants) and inertia are estimates.
